name: Castro Model Ltd.
summary: Castro Model Ltd. operates fashion stores in Israel. The company offers shirts, jeans, pants, shoes, swimwear, jackets, coats, face masks, accessories, and lingerie products for women, men, boys, and girls. It also provides knitwear, bags, and wallets for women and men; dresses and skirts for women and girls; garden suits and pajamas for boys and girls; and leotards, and sets and cases for baby girls and baby boys. In addition, the company offers gift cards. It operates through a chain of stores. The company is based in Bat Yam, Israel. Castro Model Ltd. is a subsidiary of Rotter Holdings Ltd.
